description: Neon Underground is a dark metal market crossing lit by violet, blue and amber signs. A tented stall filled with bottles and small goods occupies the left side, with a crowded pile of salvage and equipment below it. A blue-lit counter and displays stand on the right. The central floor reflects some of the coloured light, and stairs rise at the upper edge beneath a To Surface sign. Smaller passages and signs open off both side walls, while a Neon Underground sign frames the lower approach. The narrow bays and stacked merchandise give the room a layered, improvised market appearance.
